igdb_description: Arthur Morgan is a central character and the main protagonist of Red Dead Redemption 2. Arthur Morgan was born circa 1863 to Beatrice and Lyle Morgan, somewhere in the northern United States. Around 1877, Arthur was found and picked up of the streets by Dutch van der Linde and Hosea Matthews.

Dutch van der Linde is a recurring character in the Red Dead series, appearing as a central character and one of the primary antagonists of Red Dead Redemption, as well as a central character in Red Dead Redemption 2.
John Marston is the protagonist of Red Dead Redemption, and a central character in Red Dead Redemption 2. He is also the main protagonist of the non-canon Undead Nightmare expansion pack.
